why: Shop PCs are old and phones are mid-range. Budgets are measured with the CPU throttled ×4 on a cold load of each page. Sources: web.dev Core Web Vitals thresholds (LCP 2.5 s, INP 200 ms, CLS 0.1) and the RAIL frame budget (60 fps = 16.7 ms; we fail above 33 ms p95 = below 30 fps under throttling). Frames are vsync-quantised (16.7 ms = 60 fps, 33.4 ms = 30 fps): under ×4 throttling with software rendering the bar is 'never below 30 fps for 95% of frames, and at least 65% of frames at 60 fps'. Measured noise between runs is about ±5 fps, so a page must pass twice before a budget is tightened.
